tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec107/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('candidate-import.json'))
a=d['artifacts']
print(a[0]['sections']['未決事項']); print('---'); print(a[0]['sections']['テストと受入条件'][-400:]); print('---'); print(a[1]['artifact_subtypes'], a[1]['sections']['Risks and verification'])
import re
for i,x in enumerate(a):
  s=json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)
  print(i, sorted(set(re.findall(r'(評価[^\"]{0,40}|completeness[^\"]{0,40}|PASS[^\"]{0,30})',s)))[:8])
"
